name: Fangs
source: Dark skin, blonde hair styled on a sharp bob, sunglasses, toned muscles and teeth as sharp as razors, which explains her name... She is a hot blooded soldier who is confrontational, physical, but tries to understand her long term objective better, and find out where she hot her training from. That might give me a better insight into her personality and motives.
